name: Lord Günter von Christ
original_name: フォンクライスト卿ギュンター
source: Yuri's adviser and teacher. Günter is a skilled swordsman and magician. He is a very whimsical person and poetic in his thoughts. He is Anissina's number 2 test subject. He has an extremely strong attachment to Yuri and tends to pine for Yuri when has been gone from The Demon Kingdom. 20 years ago he was an instructor at a military academy.
